name: doi_lookup
description: Look up a DOI's metadata in the Crossref REST API and return it as CSL-JSON-like fields (title, authors, container, issued date, volume, issue, pages, DOI, URL, type, publisher) with an APA 7 reference in plain text and HTML. One HTTPS request per call, 15 s timeout, no key; an optional mailto joins Crossref's polite pool. Pass the body Crossref returned as response to parse it offline, without any request.

doi.description: 10.NNNN/suffix; doi: and https://doi.org/ prefixes are accepted

mailto.description: Contact e-mail for Crossref's polite pool, sent in the query string and User-Agent

response.description: The exact body Crossref returned for this DOI (offline or cached use); no request is made

output.apa: Grady, J. S., Her, M., Moreno, G., Perez, C., & Yelinek, J. (2019). Emotions in storybooks: A comparison of storybooks that represent ethnic and racial groups in the United States. Psychology of Popular Media Culture, 8(3), 207–217. https://doi.org/10.1037/ppm0000185

catalog.source: Crossref REST API (https://api.crossref.org/works/{doi}, api.crossref.org/swagger-ui); CSL-JSON field names from the Citation Style Language schema; reference format from the APA Publication Manual, 7th edition (journal article, section 10.1)
